title: Crystal Hollows
summary: Hypixel's Crystal Hollows - a huge generated cave world under the Dwarven Mines. Gemstones, Hard Stone and treasure chests, its five zones and their mobs, the Crystal Nucleus, Commissions, and how to get in.
